## Activity

During November 2023, Central Eye Clinic recorded 231 captures. Capture activity was maintained across the reporting period, and session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The reported activity provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures set out below.

## Image quality

A total of 7 captures were assessed as ungradable. This represented an ungradable rate of 3.0. The result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for November 2023. Ungradable images could not be used for grading and therefore did not contribute to the referable result reported below.

## Grading

There were 63 referable results during the reporting period. The median lag for grading was 3 days. Grading activity was completed using the available captures that met the required image-quality standard. Overall, the report records the volume of activity, the proportion of images that could not be graded, and the resulting referable workload for Central Eye Clinic.
